verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0 spec for its Store and Admin REST APIs (medusa-gh-x1) and ships an official JS SDK that installs and works out of the box (medusa-probe-rt-2), plus a documented CLI (medusa-probe-4) and extensive commerce-module docs, giving AI-native users a well-documented programmatic surface to drive the product. Missing for 10: a live, discoverable openapi.json/swagger endpoint on the docs site itself (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API completeness beyond vendor docs.
